在一片被树木围绕的小湖泊里，无言哆嗦着身子，沉在水里，给自己揉搓着身体，洗掉身上的血污。
此时虽然不是冬季，但也已经是秋季末尾了，湖里的水温度虽然没有到零下，但是也绝对不超过个位数。
要不是现在的身体已经不是以前的那个小身板能比得了的了，无言是决计不敢下来洗上一把。
一边清洗着身体，无言一边心中沉思。
如今，自己在巨兽森林的任务已经全部完成了，等级也提升到了18级，也算是一个小超人了，虽然不知道这个世界的人到底有多强，但是自保应该是够了…吧？
自己，是不是该找个有人的地方呆着去呢？
小说里不都这样说了吗？主角穿越过来之后，从山中当完野人，之后来到城市里，然后被某个大家族啊，大帝国啊，大什么什么的相中，进入势力的内部，接受测验，然后就是水晶球爆开，天才之名爆开，小宇宙爆开，这个时候，那些什么皇帝大大啊，族长大大啊，就会屁颠屁颠的跑过来说道：“嗯，是个好苗子，不知道有没有兴趣跟我女儿交往啊”什么的。
嗯…或者孙女也行啊！
啊咧咧，不是在思考要不要离开巨兽森林的问题吗？您咋就YY起来了呢？
无言丝毫不知道自己已经偏离了自己思考的主题，他正大咧着自己河马一样的嘴，嘻嘻傻笑着，看来是YY到了极处了。
泼了一把水到脸上，无言看着毫无一人的小湖泊，感概了一声。“要是有个美女来搓搓背那该多好啊…”
您想多了…
嗯…或许也没想多。
当无言的话音落下时，一个娇嫩的声音就从不远处传入无言的耳内。
“哇！是湖！太好了！我要洗个澡，浑身都难受死了。”
正在湖水之中洗着身体的无言，被这个突然响起的娇嫩声音激得浑身一抖。
不知道的人还以为他想太多，现在听到声音就满足了呢。
“小姐！你别着急啊！先让我们看看有没有危险！”这个时候，一个比之前有点稚气的声音要稳重，而且温柔上许多的女声也响了起来，好像是在对着她口中的那个小姐说话吧。
“哎呀，这么可爱的湖泊，怎么可能有危险嘛，你们在这里等着，我要进去了，受不了了。”差点一头栽倒进水里，无言很想告诉她，因为长得可爱就往里冲，您实在是趣味…

“小姐！你慢点！”
无言嘴角微微抽搐，看着一个娇小的倩影从林间跑过来，感觉某个地方有点疼。
天知道，刚才也不过是开玩笑的而已…
慢慢的，一个有着黑色的柔顺长发，穿着样式独特，一看就知道不是一个世界出产的可爱连衣裙，外套一件白色小外套的小女生出现在无言的眼前。
小女生有着一张美如天仙的脸蛋，看起来有点童颜的感觉，娇小的身躯虽然只有一米七不到，但身材却是火爆得像个魔女一样。
小美女一看到水，就呵呵娇笑了起来，不知道是不是没有看到无言，或者是真的身上难受的要命，二话不说就开始脱起了衣服，看得无言一愣一愣的。
看着这萌点十足的小美女，无言顿时淡定不能了。
“喂喂喂！你干什么！”无言几乎是汗颜的喊了出来，不为其它，就为了对面的美女身手利索，就快脱得差不多了。
无言很明显的看到对方身体一僵，保持着脱也不是，不脱也不是的姿势，然后机械一般的扭转过头来，看向了嘴角还在抽搐的自己。
两人深情（？）的对望着，场面陷入一片诡异的寂静之中。
良久，小美女的嘴巴缓缓的张大，看到这里，无言暗道一声不好。
从刚才那个对话就可以看出，小美女应该不是自己一个人，而是有同伴的。
虽然不知道她的同伴给不给力，但是要是被她喊了出来，自己就算是‘受害者’，也会尝试一把跳进黄河也洗不清的感觉。
更何况自己还是赤身，无言可不想被围观。
以上想法，都是在近乎不到一秒的时间内掠过无言心间的想法，所以，当下，无言当机立断，毫不犹豫的对着小美女喊道。
“你干什么！偷看我洗澡吗？”
小美女身体再次一僵，原本打算张成‘啊’型的嘴唇，也随着某人无耻的发言变成了‘O’型。
无言脸上面无表情，实则内心倒是轻舒了一口气。

In a small lake surrounded by trees, Wuyan shivered and sank into the water, rubbing his body to wash away the blood.
Although it was not winter at this time, it was already the end of autumn. Although the water temperature in the lake did not reach below zero, it definitely did not exceed single digits.
If it weren't for the fact that his current body was no longer comparable to the small body he had before, Wu Yan would never dare to come down and take a shower.
While washing his body, he was silent and thinking in his mind.
Now, all my tasks in the Giant Beast Forest have been completed, and my level has been raised to level 18. I can be considered a little superman. Although I don’t know how strong people in this world are, it should be enough to protect myself... right?
Shouldn't you find a place with people to stay?
Isn’t that what the novel says? After the protagonist traveled through time, he worked as a savage in the mountains, then came to the city, and then he was favored by a big family, a big empire, something big, entered the power, and took a test. Then the crystal ball exploded, the name of the genius exploded, and the small universe exploded. At this time, those emperors and patriarchs would rush over and say: "Well, he is a good young man, I wonder if he is interested in dating my daughter" or something like that.
Hmm... maybe a granddaughter too!
Ah, aren't you thinking about whether to leave the Giant Beast Forest? Why did you get up to masturbate?
Wu Yan had no idea that he had deviated from the theme of his thoughts. He was grinning like a hippopotamus and grinning. It seemed that his sexual desire had reached its extreme.
After splashing a handful of water on his face, Wu Yan looked at the deserted small lake and sighed. "It would be great if a beautiful woman could rub my back..."
Are you thinking too much...
Hmm... maybe I didn't think too much about it.
When Wu Yan's words fell, a delicate voice came into Wu Yan's ears from not far away.
"Wow! It's a lake! Great! I need to take a bath, I feel so uncomfortable all over."
Wu Yan, who was washing his body in the lake, was shaken by the sudden and delicate voice.
People who don't know think that he thinks too much and is now satisfied with hearing the sound.
"Miss! Don't worry! Let's see if there is any danger first!" At this time, a female voice that was more steady and gentle than the previous childish voice also spoke, as if she was speaking to the young lady in her mouth.
"Oh, how can such a cute lake be dangerous? You guys wait here, I'm going in, I can't stand it anymore." He almost fell into the water, Wu Yan wanted to tell her that he rushed in because he looked cute, you are really interesting...
"Miss! Slow down!"
The corner of Wu Yan's mouth twitched slightly, and he felt a little pain somewhere as he watched a petite figure running over from the forest.
God knows, it was just a joke...
Slowly, a little girl with long black silky hair, a unique style of clothing, a cute dress that was clearly not produced in another world, and a small white coat appeared in front of Wu Yan.
The little girl has a face as beautiful as a fairy, which looks a bit childish. Although her petite body is only less than 1.7 meters, her figure is as hot as a witch.
As soon as the little beauty saw the water, she burst into laughter. I don't know if she didn't see Wu Yan, or if she was really feeling terribly uncomfortable. Without saying a word, she started to take off her clothes, leaving Wu Yan stunned for a while.
Looking at this cute little beauty, Wu Yan suddenly became calm.
"Hey, hey, hey! What are you doing!" Wu Yan almost shouted out in shame, not for anything else, just for the sake of the other side.The beauty is so skillful that she is almost ready to take off her clothes.
Wu Yan clearly saw that the other party's body froze, maintaining the posture of taking off his clothes and not taking off his clothes, and then mechanically turned his head to look at himself, whose mouth was still twitching.
The two looked at each other affectionately (?), and the scene fell into an eerie silence.
For a long time, the little beauty's mouth slowly opened wide. Seeing this, she silently said something bad.
From the conversation just now, it can be seen that the little beauty is not alone, but has a companion.
Although she didn't know if her companions could help her, but if she called her out, even if she was a 'victim', she would try to jump into the Yellow River and not be able to wash away the feeling.
What's more, he was still naked, and Wu Yan didn't want to be watched.
The above thoughts were all thoughts that passed through Wuyan's heart in less than a second. Therefore, at that moment, Wuyan made a decision and shouted to the little beauty without hesitation.
"What are you doing! Are you peeking at me taking a shower?"
The little beauty's body froze again, and the lips that were originally intended to open into an 'ah' shape became an 'O' shape following someone's shameless speech.
Wu Yan's face was expressionless, but actually he breathed a sigh of relief inside.
